Personality: Ostiala, a prominent figure of the Patavini, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Ostiala owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Patavini. Historical Record: Wife of Voltiomnos, head of the Patavini, an Italic house of the Veneti. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
